responsibility: Defines the front end’s enumeration of aggregate and special constant categories, such as set, string, constructor, array, cast, and typed pseudo-constants. This file currently serves as the type declaration point for constant-metadata classification rather than implementing active resolution logic itself.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file is the only substantive part of the M2Const pair in this revision: it defines and exports the `constType` enumeration used to classify constants, whereas `M2Const.mod` contains no active constant-resolution logic.
